```{r}
# MA677 Final Project


set.seed(677)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create folders
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!dir.exists("data")) {
  dir.create("data")
}

if (!dir.exists("figures")) {
  dir.create("figures")
}

if (!dir.exists("output")) {
  dir.create("output")
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Simulate simple 2x2 DiD data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_per_group <- 100
time_periods <- c(0, 1)

data <- expand.grid(
  id = 1:(2 * n_per_group),
  post = time_periods
)

# First 100 units are control, next 100 are treated
data$treat <- ifelse(data$id > n_per_group, 1, 0)

# True treatment effect
true_effect <- 3

# Outcome model:
# baseline = 10
# treated baseline difference = 2
# common post-period time trend = 1.5
# treatment effect = 3 for treated units in post period
data$y <- 10 +
  2 * data$treat +
  1.5 * data$post +
  true_effect * (data$treat * data$post) +
  rnorm(nrow(data), mean = 0, sd = 1)

write.csv(data, "data/simulated_did_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Compute simple 2x2 DiD estimate
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mean_table <- aggregate(
  y ~ treat + post,
  data = data,
  FUN = mean
)

print(mean_table)

control_pre  <- mean_table$y[mean_table$treat == 0 & mean_table$post == 0]
control_post <- mean_table$y[mean_table$treat == 0 & mean_table$post == 1]
treated_pre  <- mean_table$y[mean_table$treat == 1 & mean_table$post == 0]
treated_post <- mean_table$y[mean_table$treat == 1 & mean_table$post == 1]

did_estimate <- (treated_post - treated_pre) - (control_post - control_pre)

cat("\nSimple 2x2 DiD estimate:", did_estimate, "\n")
cat("True treatment effect:", true_effect, "\n")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Estimate DiD regression
# ------------------------------------------------------------

did_model <- lm(y ~ treat + post + treat:post, data = data)

summary(did_model)

did_regression_estimate <- coef(did_model)["treat:post"]

cat("\nRegression DiD estimate:", did_regression_estimate, "\n")


# Save regression output
sink("output/did_regression_output.txt")
cat("Simple 2x2 DiD estimate:", did_estimate, "\n")
cat("True treatment effect:", true_effect, "\n\n")
print(mean_table)
cat("\n")
print(summary(did_model))
sink()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot simple DiD trends
# ------------------------------------------------------------

group_means <- mean_table
group_means$group <- ifelse(group_means$treat == 1, "Treated", "Control")
group_means$period <- ifelse(group_means$post == 1, "Post", "Pre")

png("figures/did_trends.png", width = 900, height = 650)

plot(
  group_means$post[group_means$treat == 0],
  group_means$y[group_means$treat == 0],
  type = "b",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  ylim = range(group_means$y),
  xaxt = "n",
  xlab = "Time Period",
  ylab = "Average Outcome",
  main = "Difference-in-Differences Illustration"
)

axis(1, at = c(0, 1), labels = c("Pre", "Post"))

lines(
  group_means$post[group_means$treat == 1],
  group_means$y[group_means$treat == 1],
  type = "b",
  pch = 17,
  lwd = 2
)

# Counterfactual treated trend based on control group's time trend
counterfactual_treated_post <- treated_pre + (control_post - control_pre)

segments(
  x0 = 0,
  y0 = treated_pre,
  x1 = 1,
  y1 = counterfactual_treated_post,
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)

segments(
  x0 = 1,
  y0 = counterfactual_treated_post,
  x1 = 1,
  y1 = treated_post,
  lty = 3,
  lwd = 2
)

text(
  x = 1,
  y = (counterfactual_treated_post + treated_post) / 2,
  labels = "DiD effect",
  pos = 4
)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("Control", "Treated", "Treated counterfactual"),
  pch = c(16, 17, NA),
  lty = c(1, 1, 2),
  lwd = c(2, 2, 2),
  bty = "n"
)

dev.off()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Simulate event-study style data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(678)

n_units <- 200
time_points <- -4:4

event_data <- expand.grid(
  id = 1:n_units,
  event_time = time_points
)

event_data$treat <- ifelse(event_data$id > n_units / 2, 1, 0)

# Treatment begins at event_time = 0
event_data$post <- ifelse(event_data$event_time >= 0, 1, 0)

# Dynamic treatment effect:
# zero before treatment, positive after treatment
event_data$treatment_effect <- ifelse(
  event_data$treat == 1 & event_data$event_time >= 0,
  1 + 0.5 * event_data$event_time,
  0
)

# Outcome:
# common time trend + treated baseline difference + treatment effect
event_data$y <- 10 +
  2 * event_data$treat +
  0.5 * event_data$event_time +
  event_data$treatment_effect +
  rnorm(nrow(event_data), mean = 0, sd = 1)

write.csv(event_data, "data/simulated_event_study_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Estimate event-study style regression
# ------------------------------------------------------------

event_data$event_time_factor <- factor(event_data$event_time)

event_model <- lm(
  y ~ treat + event_time_factor + treat:event_time_factor,
  data = event_data
)

summary(event_model)

sink("output/event_study_regression_output.txt")
print(summary(event_model))
sink()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot event-study style group means
# ------------------------------------------------------------

event_means <- aggregate(
  y ~ treat + event_time,
  data = event_data,
  FUN = mean
)

png("figures/event_study_group_trends.png", width = 900, height = 650)

plot(
  event_means$event_time[event_means$treat == 0],
  event_means$y[event_means$treat == 0],
  type = "b",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  ylim = range(event_means$y),
  xlab = "Event Time",
  ylab = "Average Outcome",
  main = "Event Study Style Plot"
)

lines(
  event_means$event_time[event_means$treat == 1],
  event_means$y[event_means$treat == 1],
  type = "b",
  pch = 17,
  lwd = 2
)

abline(v = 0, lty = 2, lwd = 2)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("Control", "Treated", "Treatment starts"),
  pch = c(16, 17, NA),
  lty = c(1, 1, 2),
  lwd = c(2, 2, 2),
  bty = "n"
)

dev.off()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Extract event-study interaction coefficients
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coef_table <- summary(event_model)$coefficients

interaction_rows <- grepl("treat:event_time_factor", rownames(coef_table))

event_coef <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(coef_table)[interaction_rows],
  estimate = coef_table[interaction_rows, "Estimate"],
  std_error = coef_table[interaction_rows, "Std. Error"],
  p_value = coef_table[interaction_rows, "Pr(>|t|)"]
)

# Extract event time from term names
event_coef$event_time <- as.numeric(
  gsub("treat:event_time_factor", "", event_coef$term)
)

write.csv(event_coef, "output/event_study_coefficients.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(event_coef)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Plot event-study coefficients
# ------------------------------------------------------------

png("figures/event_study_coefficients.png", width = 900, height = 650)

plot(
  event_coef$event_time,
  event_coef$estimate,
  type = "b",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  ylim = range(
    event_coef$estimate - 1.96 * event_coef$std_error,
    event_coef$estimate + 1.96 * event_coef$std_error
  ),
  xlab = "Event Time",
  ylab = "Estimated Treatment Effect",
  main = "Event Study Coefficients"
)

arrows(
  x0 = event_coef$event_time,
  y0 = event_coef$estimate - 1.96 * event_coef$std_error,
  x1 = event_coef$event_time,
  y1 = event_coef$estimate + 1.96 * event_coef$std_error,
  angle = 90,
  code = 3,
  length = 0.05
)

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
abline(v = 0, lty = 2)

dev.off()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Final printed summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Project outputs created successfully.\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Data files:\n")
cat("- data/simulated_did_data.csv\n")
cat("- data/simulated_event_study_data.csv\n\n")
cat("Figures:\n")
cat("- figures/did_trends.png\n")
cat("- figures/event_study_group_trends.png\n")
cat("- figures/event_study_coefficients.png\n\n")
cat("Regression outputs:\n")
cat("- output/did_regression_output.txt\n")
cat("- output/event_study_regression_output.txt\n")
cat("- output/event_study_coefficients.csv\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```
